svg.text: Each layer asks for a few experts. Hot ones are already in RAM; the rest are read from storage, just in time.
the whole model file: every expert of every layer
much larger than RAM: 21 GB to 284 GB in the examples
attention, router, embeddings: read every token
the experts used most, kept from token to token
sized by the planner to what this machine can spare
same output as fully in memory
